title: What Is Ethereum? The Complete Story Every Investor Must Know
description:
What if the world's second-largest cryptocurrency was born out of rejection, childhood trauma, and a lunch meeting that changed the future of money? This is the untold story of Ethereum — where it came from, how it almost died, and why it still matters in 2026.

In this video, we dive deep into the origin story of Ethereum — from the personal wounds that shaped its creator, to the brutal attack that nearly killed the network, to the incredible revival that made it a global financial force. Whether you're a crypto beginner or a seasoned investor, this is the story you need to know.

🔥 What You'll Learn:
The childhood struggles that fuelled the vision behind Ethereum
How Bitcoin introduced the world to decentralised money — and why it wasn't enough
The legendary lunch meeting that gave birth to Ethereum
The infamous attack on the Ethereum network and how it shook the entire crypto world
The remarkable comeback story that proved Ethereum was built to survive
What the future holds for Ethereum in an evolving crypto landscape

Time Stamp 
0:00 Introduction 
1:06 Chapter 1 THE CHILDHOOD & THE WOUND 
3:35 Chapter 2 Introduction to Bitcoin  
6:18 Chapter 3  The Ethereum Lunch  
7:25 Chapter 4 The Attack on Ethereum  
8:10  Chapter 5 The Revival Story of Ethereum  
10:02 Chapter 6 What is the Future of Ethereum ?
11:50 Conclusion
